How It Works

RazorpayX Payout Links removes the friction, time, and effort required to collect bank account details to make payouts. Just enter the beneficiary’s contact details and we do the rest - from sending the link to collect bank account/UPI details, processing the payout and giving you the confirmation!

Step 1- Create a Payout Link via API or Dashboard

Step 2- Share the Payout Link over SMS, Email etc.

Step 3- Beneficiary enters preferred bank account / UPI ID.

Step 4- Payout instantly processed to beneficiary account

Why Payout Links

Making payouts when you don’t have bank account details can be a tedious, time-consuming process. Here’s how RazorpayX Payout Links can benefit your business with a frictionless payout experience.
Make instant payouts to UPI handles or bank accounts.
Automatic retry of transactions to ensure a higher success rate.
Payout confirmation notification with UTR number for customers.
Create hundreds of Payout Links using Bulk Payout Links.

Frequently Asked Questions

FAQs

What can I do with a RazorpayX Payout Link?
What can I do with a RazorpayX Payout Link?

RazorpayX Payout Link automates collection of bank account details and processes payouts instantly. You can share this with your customers, vendors, employees or anyone for making payouts like refunds, cashbacks, rewards or vendor payments.

How do I create a RazorpayX Payout Link?
How do I create a RazorpayX Payout Link?

  • You can create Payout Links either via RazorpayX Dashboard or APIs.
    On the Dashboard:
    • Go to the Payout Links app from your RazorpayX Dashboard.
    • Click on 'Create Payout Link' button.
    • Fill customer information and amount to be paid out and send it.
  • You can refer to the API Documentation here - Link
Can I create multiple Payout Links at a time?
Can I create multiple Payout Links at a time?

Yes, you can create multiple Payout Links using Bulk Payout Links.

  • Go to the Payout Links app from your RazorpayX Dashboard and switch to the ‘Bulk Payout Links’ tab.
  • Click on the ‘Create Bulk Payout Link’ button.
  • Populate the data in the template file and upload it.
  • Preview the uploaded file and confirm the payouts using an OTP.

What are the advantages of a Payout Link?
What are the advantages of a Payout Link?

  • Process 24*7, Instant payouts via Bank Account Details or UPI ID.
  • Remove the effort and time required to manually collect bank account details from your customers, vendors or any party.
  • Complete visibility on the transaction and notification upon payout.
  • Automatic Retry of transactions to ensure payout success for you and your customers.

How can I send a RazorpayX Payout Link?
How can I send a RazorpayX Payout Link?

You can send a RazorpayX Payout Link to your customer via email and SMS. RazorpayX handles sending the Payout Link to the customer. In case you want to send the Payout Link from your end, we have an option for that as well.

Are there any additional charges to send SMS and Email?
Are there any additional charges to send SMS and Email?

No, there are no additional charges to send SMS or Email. You can send unlimited Payout Links. RazorpayX will only charge you for the payouts made.

A comprehensive payments suite in India designed to help businesses seamlessly accept, process, and disburse payments. It gives you access to all payment modes including credit card, debit card, netbanking, UPI and popular wallets including JioMoney, Mobikwik, Airtel Money, FreeCharge, Ola Money and PayZapp.
RazorpayX supercharges your business banking experience, bringing effectiveness, efficiency, and excellence to all financial processes. With RazorpayX, businesses can get access to fully-functional current accounts, supercharge their payouts and automate payroll compliance.
Manage your marketplace, automate bank transfers, collect recurring payments, share invoices with customers and avail working capital loans - all from a single platform. Fast forward your business with Razorpay.
Disclaimer: The RazorpayX powered Current Account and VISA corporate credit card are provided by RBI licensed banks. Your RazorpayX powered account is provided by our partner bank, in accordance with RBI regulations. RazorpayX itself is not a bank and doesn't hold or claim to hold a banking license.
